subject: Animation
title: The Nine Old Men of Disney
description: Learn The Nine Old Men of Disney in one minute.

hook.text: Disney's core animators were called the Nine Old Men — they defined the look and feel of animated storytelling.

buildup.text: Artists like Frank Thomas, Ollie Johnston, and Milt Kahl created characters with unprecedented emotional range.

discovery.text: They codified the twelve principles of animation — rules that every animator in the world still learns.

twist.text: Despite creating Disney's greatest works, most of the Nine Old Men remained unknown to the general public.

climax.text: The Nine Old Men built the artistic foundation that Disney animation still stands on today.

punchline.text: Nine unknown artists wrote the rules every animator follows.

quiz.question: What lasting contribution did Disney's Nine Old Men make?
options: They codified the twelve principles of animation that every animator worldwide still learns
They directed all Disney theme parks
